name: bochkivtsi_relief_alt_heading
description: Query flight for the bochkivtsi_relief reference layers (500/1000/2000 m, base datum, heading-hold 0, north-up): altitude AND heading change in one video. No yaw profile, so the camera yaw follows the course (heading-follow); no pitch/roll profiles, so the camera stays nadir and only scale and rotation vary. Phases separate altitude-only, heading-only and simultaneous changes; it covers a full 360 deg orbit at 1000 m, one abrupt 90 deg corner at 500 m and a dip below the lowest layer. Altitudes are above the base plane (lowest DEM point), like the reference layers. Record with --zoom 18 --speed 50 --altitude-reference base and WITHOUT --heading-hold-deg. Phase times are approximate (kinematic estimate of the autopilot at 50 m/s).

phases.label: acquire_1000
phases.note: cold start on the 1000 m layer (main), heading 60 deg, nadir

phases.label: climb_1000_2000_straight
phases.note: altitude only: straight leg at 60 deg; handoff main -> 2 at 1414 m (t~30)

phases.label: turn_at_2000
phases.note: heading only: right turn 60 -> 150 deg at the exact scale of layer 2

phases.label: descend_while_turning
phases.note: both: 2000 -> 1000 m descent during a left turn 150 -> 30 deg (t~82-106); handoff 2 -> main at 1414 m (t~103)

phases.label: descend_straight
phases.note: altitude only: end of the descent on heading 30 deg

phases.label: orbit_1000
phases.note: heading only: full 360 deg right orbit at 1000 m (t~124-170, every heading at the exact main-layer scale, ~30 deg steps), then right turn 30 -> 100 deg

phases.label: descend_1000_500_straight
phases.note: altitude only: heading ~98 deg; handoff main -> 3 at 707 m (t~198)

phases.label: low_corner_dip
phases.note: 500 m: abrupt 90 deg corner (98 -> 183 deg within one GT slot, t~214), then a dip to 450 m below the lowest layer (t 216-228)

phases.label: climb_while_uturn
phases.note: both: 500 -> 1000 m climb (232-262) during a left U-turn 183 -> 25 deg (t~233-265); handoff 3 -> main at 707 m (t~244)

phases.label: cruise_1000
phases.note: 1000 m, heading 25 deg; the route is longer than the flight so the drone never stops and hovers
